hero.name: Lakshay Agarwal
hero.tagline: Driven by curiosity. Motivated towards perfection. Seeking mastery.
hero.lede: Transforming ideas into user-focused products — from assistive devices and innovative mechanical systems to engineering research and rapid prototyping.

paragraphs: Mechanical Engineer and M.Tech candidate at IIT Delhi specializing in Mechanical Design. Strong understanding of transforming ideas into user-focused products through the Product Design process.

Experienced in solving practical engineering problems with a functional design mindset, spanning assistive devices, user-focused products, and innovative mechanical systems. Highly proficient in SolidWorks, ANSYS Workbench, engineering analysis, and rapid prototyping, with a focus on building efficient, practical, and impactful products.
I'm always open to interesting work — if you've got something exciting, hit me up.

projects.title: Automated Four-Bar Linkage Design using Neural Networks
bullets: Developed a machine learning pipeline in Python to predict four-bar linkage dimensions from user-drawn coupler paths.
Built an image-processing workflow using OpenCV to convert hand-drawn paths into neural-network readable trajectory data.
Generated synthetic training datasets through forward kinematics of random valid linkage parameters for supervised learning.

projects.title: Exoskeleton Design: Lower Limb Development & Spine Biomechanical Research
bullets: Researched human gait and joint loading alongside existing exoskeleton systems to establish assistive device design requirements.
Studied spinal loading and posture mechanics, with early-stage concept exploration for a spine assistive device.
Evaluated four joint actuation concepts against wearability, torque, and control requirements, selecting direct joint actuation.
Performed musculoskeletal simulation and optimal control analysis in OpenSim to validate actuator sizing and produce a preliminary CAD model.

projects.title: Self-Initiated Ergonomic Accessory Design
bullets: Designed a height and tilt adjustable phone stand tailored to specific ergonomic requirements.
Refined through multiple digital and physical iterations, with the final design validated through daily use.
Designed a foldable, height-adjustable laptop stand around ergonomic and thermal constraints, pending physical validation.

projects.title: Development of Refractory Bricks using Mining Waste
bullets: Developed sustainable refractory brick compositions using mining waste for high-temperature engineering applications.
Designed and fabricated a custom thermal testing setup to evaluate heat resistance and material performance.
Worked on material selection, testing methodology, and practical feasibility for industrial use cases.

projects.title: SAG Web Application Design
bullets: Led UI/UX design for a student activity web platform, applying user research and product-thinking to translate user needs into intuitive workflows and clean information architecture.
Developed design language, interface consistency standards, and user-flow logic across platform modules.

leadership.title: Founder & Captain — Tech Bizz Club
bullets: Co-founded a student technical club to promote hands-on engineering and problem-solving culture.
Worked on and mentored several student-led technical projects across mechanical, electronics, and software domains.
Organised innovation challenges, design competitions, technical workshops, and high-participation engineering events.
Led cross-functional student teams, coordinated club operations, and executed initiatives with minimal resources.
